informative.title: Delineate PPG pulse fiducials
informative.summary: Locates apex, basal, mid-amplitude and optional derivative-based onset times for each pulse detection.

references.note: Equations 2 to 4 define the onset relative to maximum upslope. This interface accepts the derivative from the caller.
Equations 3 and 4 define the basal reference and mid-amplitude point for PRV. This method uses configurable detection-relative extrema windows and refines their times.

definitions.text: Accept times from 0 through (N-1)/fs inclusive before rounding. Multiply times and window durations by fs, then round to the nearest sample, with positive half ties upward. Process each detection independently in its original position.

On the uninterrupted PPG span containing the detection sample D, use tools.localmax on PPG[D:D+round(window_a*fs)] for A and on negated PPG[D-round(window_b*fs):D] for B. Intervals include both ends and are clipped to available samples. Endpoints are excluded from the local peaks.

For sampled A and B refine the time using their immediate neighbors. For a selected sample p in a signal y, add (y[p-1]-y[p+1])/(2*(y[p-1]-2*y[p]+y[p+1])) to p before dividing by fs. A flat three-sample fit gives NaN.

In the inclusive sampled interval B to A, select the earliest sample closest to (PPG[B]+PPG[A])/2. Refine its time using the negative absolute amplitude error on that interval. Keep an endpoint selected in this interval at its sample time.

Use the supplied real derivative aligned with PPG, of the same length, with NaNs allowed and infinities rejected. Search backward from sampled A by up to round(0.3*fs) samples, stopping at a gap in either input. Require at least two available samples and a positive maximum derivative. U is the earliest sample attaining that maximum. From the start of the available window through U, use a threshold of 0.05*dppg[U]. If any sample is at or below the threshold, choose the earliest sample closest to it. Otherwise choose the last interior local minimum (earlier center of a plateau); if none exists use the earliest absolute minimum. Return the selected sample time without refinement.

Python returns all four arrays and silently fills t_o with NaNs when dppg is omitted. MATLAB permits up to three outputs without dppg and raises an error if the fourth is requested. Neither implementation computes a derivative.

behavior.nan_handling: Preserve a missing detection or a detection on missing PPG as a missing entry in every output. PPG gaps stop each search; derivative gaps affect onset only.
behavior.empty_input: Reject empty PPG. Empty detection times yield empty outputs, subject to the MATLAB fourth-output requirement.
behavior.input_orientation: Accept row and column vectors. Preserve order and duplicates. MATLAB returns column vectors and Python one-dimensional arrays.
behavior.insufficient_data: Keep undefined fiducials as NaN. Missing sampled A or B prevents computing M. Missing sampled A prevents computing O.
